title: The One on the Doorstep
subtitle: 蜜蜂与昆虫 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 蜜蜂与昆虫（自然生态·昆虫与授粉）
meta: 主题语境：蜜蜂与昆虫（自然生态·昆虫与授粉）　|　核心词汇：bee　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bee 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 my grandfather kept ① a bee in a jar for nine minutes and let it go, and my grandmother said the letting go was the whole of the keeping. The ② bee, meaning the insect and not the gathering, was one of eleven thousand and was never counted again; a bee, he said, is the only creature that is measured by what it does for somebody else.

Every ③ bee in that hive had a job for nine days and another for the rest, and the ④ bee on the doorstep, meaning the tired one she carried out on a leaf and not either of those, was the only one anybody in the house ever named. A bee, my mother said, is nine parts work and one part a queen nobody has seen; my grandfather said the work is the part you can hear.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ bee was the whole of the evening, meaning the gathering and not the insect. The ⑥ bee, meaning the working party and not any of that, is the only party where everybody arrives with something to do; a bee, she said, is either an insect in a jar or the only word that means both a creature and a meeting. He said the meeting came first in their family.

By 1963 the ⑦ bee had become a photograph in a newspaper, and the newspaper had become an argument about the orchard. The ⑧ bee of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in June, was eleven thousand insects and one hive that failed in March; a bee, he said, is either the thing in the jar or the reason the apples came. She said the apples were the part that mattered.

The ⑨ bee I remember is the one on the doorstep, which she carried out on a leaf and which flew away in the afternoon. A ⑩ bee, my grandmother said in 1966, is the only creature that improves by being let go; every bee, she said, is a meeting that has agreed to look like an insect. He said the meeting never needed a jar.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 蜜蜂（指那只虫子，与集会相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a bee 把一只蜜蜂养／关着
D. n. 蜜蜂（指蜂群里每一只）
E. n. 蜜蜂（指门阶上那一只）
F. n. 聚会；协作劳动的集会（指那个傍晚的聚会）
G. n. 集会（抽象：大家一起干活的那种聚会）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The bee, meaning the insect and not the gathering
bee was the whole of the evening
The bee, meaning the working party
the bee had become a photograph in a newspaper
The bee of the whole thing
A bee, my grandmother said in 1966

answers.why: keep a bee 意为“把一只蜜蜂养／关着”，1951 年祖父把一只蜜蜂关在罐子里九分钟，然后放了它。
bee 意为“蜜蜂”，指那只虫子而不是集会，它是一万一千只中的一只，此后再没被数过。
bee 指蜂群里每一只蜜蜂，每一个都有九天的活儿，之后又换一种活儿。
bee 指门阶上那一只（她用一片叶子托出去的那只累坏了的），是屋里唯一有人给它取名的。
bee 意为“聚会”，指那个傍晚大家一起干活的集会，姑姑说 bee 就是那个傍晚的全部。
bee 为抽象用法，指大家一起干活的那种聚会，是唯一人人都带着活儿来的聚会。
bee 意为“蜜蜂”，到 1963 年这个 bee 成了报纸上的一张照片。
bee 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖父六月写道，整件事权衡下来是一万一千只虫子和三月失败的一个蜂箱。
bee 意为“蜜蜂”，我记得的是门阶上那一只，她用一片叶子把它托了出去，下午它飞走了。
bee 为抽象总称，祖母说蜜蜂是唯一会因为被放走而变好的生物。
